rows.name: ARC-AGI-1
rows.focus: Abstraction and Reasoning Corpus (2019, 'Challenges Deep Learning'): tests AI systems' ability to deal with reasoning problems they had not been prepared for, i.e. skill acquisition rather than any predefined task.
rows.metrics: quality, cost, effort, date, breakdown, other
rows.metrics_detail:
Quality [page]: ARC-AGI-1 — % of Semi-Private tasks solved (evaluations.v1_Semi_Private.score, 0-1) · https://arcprize.org/leaderboard
Cost [page]: Cost/task — USD per task (costPerTask), also x-axis of the score-vs-cost chart · https://arcprize.org/leaderboard
Cost [page]: $X input / $Y output per 1M tokens — model API price on the results-page header (per model, not per benchmark) · https://arcprize.org/results/openai-gpt-6-2-astra
Effort [page]: AI System / Effort — separate row per reasoning
rows.notes: Leaderboard page is Next.js; values read from the server-rendered HTML and its embedded React flight data (groups/rows/evaluations, datasets v1_Semi_Private, v2_Semi_Private, v3_Semi_Private) on https://arcprize.org/leaderboard. Ranking = one entry per model (best effort), ties broken by lower cost, matching the page's 1st/2nd/3rd place medals. Human Panel (100% on ARC-AGI-2) excluded as not a ranked system. Semi-private set. ARC-AGI-1 is saturated: 11 systems tie at 98.5%; order is by lower cost/task ($0.059, $0.065, $0.158) per the page's tie rule. No per-version leaderboard URL; the ARC-AGI-1 column is on /leaderboard.
rows.difficulty_detail:
Fitted level L3 (Advanced); bootstrap agreement: L3 98%.
Placed from 50 models' published scores.
Best observed: Gemini 4 Argon 98.5, Gemini 3.8 Flash 98.5, GPT-6.2 Astra 98.5.
Official difficulty: 'Easy for humans but challenging for AI' (arcprize.org/arc-agi/1); 800 grid tasks with ~3 examples each.

rows.metrics: quality, cost, effort, date, breakdown, other

Cost [page]: $X input / $Y output per 1M tokens — model API price on the results-page header (per model, not per benchmark) · https://arcprize.org/results/openai-gpt-6-2-astra

rows.notes: Leaderboard page is Next.js; values read from the server-rendered HTML and its embedded React flight data (groups/rows/evaluations, datasets v1_Semi_Private, v2_Semi_Private, v3_Semi_Private) on https://arcprize.org/leaderboard. Ranking = one entry per model (best effort), ties broken by lower cost, matching the page's 1st/2nd/3rd place medals. Human Panel (100% on ARC-AGI-2) excluded as not a ranked system. rows.name: AIME 2025

rows.metrics: quality, cost, time, tokens, uncertainty, runs, effort, breakdown, other
rows.metrics_detail:
Quality [page]: Accuracy (± 95% CI) — % of the 30 problems (AIME I+II) correct, averaged over runs · https://matharena.ai/competition_tables/aime--aime_2025
Cost [page]: Cost — 'Cost in USD for one model run on one problem' (tooltip) · https://matharena.ai/competition_tables/aime--aime_2025
Time [page]: Average Time — 'Average time taken per answer' · https://matharena.ai/competition_tables/aime--aime_2025
Tokens [page]: Output Tokens / Input Tokens — average output / input tokens per answer · h
rows.notes: JS page; values from https://matharena.ai/competition_tables/aime--aime_2025 (JSON 'table' HTML the page loads), fetched 2026-11-26. Marked 'Deprecated' under 'Final-Answer Comps' (no longer updated). AIME I and II are not separate on MathArena (one 30-problem competition). Models marked ⚠️ on the page ('Model was released after competition release', possible contamination): all three. Score = Accuracy (± 95% CI). 30 problems, 61 models (per /competitions). Page shows tied rank 1. Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/MathArena/aime_2025
rows.difficulty_detail:
